senses.gloss: मत्त- + आलम्ब मत्त- + आलम्ब (vb. मद्), m. a fence round the walls of a palace.
मत्स्य- + गन्ध मत्स्य- + गन्ध, adj., f. धा, smelling of fishes, MBh. 1, 2398.
मति- + गर्भ मति- + गर्भ, adj. full of understanding, Śiś. 9, 62.

मातृ- + चक्र मातृ- + चक्र (see
 7.).
मातृ- + नामन् मातृ- + नामन्, adj. called after his mother's name, ib.
मत्स्य- + नाशन मत्स्य- + नाशन, m. an osprey.
मत् मत्, see 2. मद्.

मतंग मतंग, i. e. मत (vb. मन्), + म्-ग, m.
 1. A cloud.
 2. An elephant. Hiḍ. 1, 13.
 3. A proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 19, 14.
मतंगज मतंग-ज, m. An elephant, Mālav. 32, 6; Kir. 5, 47.
मतल्लिका मतल्लिका, f. Excellence.

मति मति, i. e. मन् + ति, f.
 1. Mind, Pañc. iii. d. 76.
 2. Understanding, Pañc. 251, 6; intelligence, Hit. pr. d. 42.
 3. Thought, Pañc. iii. d. 258; resolution, Pañc. 216, 14.
 4. Hymn, Chr. 292, 2 = Rigv. i. 86, 2.
 5. Perception, Bhāṣāp. 126.
 6. Opinion, Chr. 13, 13.
 7. Advice.
 8. Wish.
 9. Recollection.
 10. Respect.
 11. A potherb.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. mens, mentis, mentio, mentiri, mendax; Goth. ga-munds, môds; A.S. mod, ge-mynd; μῆτις (ved. -माति), μοῦσα, i. e. μαν + τία (= ved. मति, hymn).
मतिमन्त् मति-मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Sensible, intelligent, wise, Pañc. ii. d. 20; Hit. i. d. 127, M.M.

मत्क मत्क,
 1. i. e. 2. मद् + क, adj. Mine.
 2. m. A bug.

मत्कुण मत्कुण,
 1. A bug (cf. मत्क), Pañc. iii. d. 105.
 2. A flea.
 3. An elephant without tusks.
 4. A beardless man.
 5. A buffalo.
 6. Armour for the thighs or legs.
 6. A cocoa-nut.
मत्य मत्य, n. The handle of a sickle.

मत्सर मत्सर, probably 2. मअ-सृ + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Envious, hostile, Utt. Rāmac. 133, 13.
 2. Niggardly.
 3. Wicked.
 II. m.
 1. Envy, Śiś. 9, 63; Man. 3, 231.
 2. Jealousy, Mālav. 55, 8.
 3. Anger, passion.
 III. f. रा, A gnat.
 --Comp.
मात्सर मात्सर, i. e. मत्सर + अ, adj. Envious.

मत्सरिन् मत्सरिन्, i. e. मत्सर + इन्, [] adj., f. इणी.
 1. Envious, Man. 2, 201.
 2. Wicked.

मत्स्य मत्स्य, i. e. 1. मद् + स्य,
 1. m. A fish, Man. 1, 39.
 2. A particular fish, probably the सफरी.
 3. A name of Viṣṇu.
 4. The name of a country, Man. 2, 19; 7, 193.
 --Comp.
मत्स्यक मत्स्य + क, m. A fish, Matsyop. 35.
मात्स्यक मात्स्यक, i. e. मत्स्य + क, adj. Relating to a fish, Matsyop. 58.
मत्स्यण्डी मत्स्यण्डी, and मत्स्यण्डिका मत्स्यण्डिका, i. e. मत्स्यण्डी + क, f. The juice of the sugar-cane, unrefined, Mālav. 30, 19.
मत्स्याद मत्स्याद, i. e. मत्स्य-अद् + अ, adj. Feeding on fishes, Pañc. 50, 14.

मातङ्ग मातङ्ग, i. e. मतंग + अ,
 I. m.
 1. An outcaste, Rājat. 5, 6.
 2. A barbarian.
 3. An elephant, Hit. ii. d. 63.
 4. The sacred fig-tree, Ficus religiosa.
 II. f. गी, Pārvatī.
मातरिश्वन् मातरिश्वन्, i. e. मातृ + इ-श्वन् (vb. श्वि), m. Air, wind, Chr. 27, 4; Kir. 5, 36; Daśak. in Chr. 200, 12.
मातलि मातलि, m. The charioteer of Indra, Śāk. 94, 14.
मातापितृ माता-पितृ (माता, nom. sing. of मातृ), m. du. Mother and father, Man. 3, 157.

मातामह माता-मह (माता, nom. sing. of मातृ),
 1. m. A maternal grandfather, Vikr. d. 101.
 2. f. हि, A maternal grandmother, Rājat. 5, 289.

मातुल मातुल, i. e. मतृ + अ,
 I. m. A maternal uncle, Rājat. 5, 292; Pañc. 215, 10.
 II. f. ला, ली, and लानि, The wife of a maternal uncle.
 III. f. लानी, Hemp, Cannabis sativa.
मातुलक मातुल + क, m. Dear uncle, Pañc. 52, 11.

मातृ मा + तृ, f.
 1. A mother, Pañc. ii. d. 190.
 2. A divine mother, the personified energy of a deity, Pañc. pr. d. 1; MBh. 9, 2619 sqq.
 3. The wife of a Brāhmaṇa.
 4. The earth.
 5. A cow.
 6. Space, æther.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. mater; μήτηρ; A.S. móder.

मातृक मातृ + क,
 I. adj. Maternal, Man. 9, 92.
 II. f. का.
 1. A mother.
 2. A nurse, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 3.
 3. A goddess.
 4. The alphabet.
 --Comp.
मातृवत् मातृ + वत्, adv. As a mother, as with a mother, Man. 2, 133; as on a mother, Hit. i. d. 13, M.M.
मातृष्वसृ मातृष्वसृ, i. e. मातृ-स्रसृ, f. A mother's sister.

मातृष्वसेय मातृष्वसेय, and मातृष्वस्रीय मातृष्वस्रीय, i. e. मातृ-ष्वसृ + एय, or ईय,
 1. m. A mother's sister's son.
 2. f. सेयी, स्रीया, A mother's sister's daughter.

मात्र मा + त्र,
 I. f. त्रा.
 1. Measure, Hit. 121, 5 (distance).
 2. Quantity, Pañc. 32, 24; 226. 14 (द्रव्य-, f. All things of value).
 3. Wealth, substance, Pañc. 34, 13.
 4. Requisite, Pañc. 265, 5 (luggage); material.
 5. A little, a trifle, Pañc. i. d. 46; an atom, Man. 1, 27; an element. Bhag. 2, 14 (also n., Bhāg. P. 5, 11, 9).
 6. A moment.
 7. A short vowel.
 8. Quantity in metre, Pañc. v. d. 43.
 9. An ear-ring.
 II. n.
 1. The totality, the whole, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 17.
 2. As latter part of comp. words (Being limited), alone, only, Cāṇ. 70 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 411 (cf. comp.).
 3. As [] latter part of compounds, often almost without any signification; cf. e. g. अर्थ-मात्र.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μέτρον.

ऽमात्रक -मात्र + क, a substitute for मात्र, when latter part of a comp. adj.; e. g. अङ्गुष्ठ-, adj. As long as a thumb, Nal. 14, 9. स्तन्य-त्याग-, adj. In which (viz. age), one is just weaned, Utt. Rāmac. 34, 16.

मात्सर्य मात्सर्य, i. e. मत्सर + य, n.
 1. Envy, Hit. i. d. 194, M.M.
 2. Malice.
 --Comp.
मातृ- + मुख मातृ- + मुख, m. a fool.
मातृ- + शून्यता मातृ- + शून्यता, f. condition of having no mother, Cāṇ. 49 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 410.
मत्त-इभ-कुम्भ-विदलन-कृत- + श्रम मत्त-इभ-कुम्भ-विदलन-कृत- + श्रम, adj. one who has ever endeavoured to tear to pieces the frontal globes of furious elephants, Pañc. i. d. 351.
मातृ- + षष्ठ मातृ- + षष्ठ, adj. six, inclusively of the mother, Hiḍ. 1, 1.
